Repository Guidelines

Project Structure & Module Organization

  • R/ houses exported client functions and internal helpers; group workflows by domain (auth, resources, steps).
  • inst/ ships CLI binaries, templates, and other runtime assets bundled with the package.
  • man/, doc/, docs/, vignettes/, and pkgdown/ support roxygen docs and the pkgdown site; update via devtools before release.
  • tests/testthat/ contains automated specs; test-*.R files run by default, while _test-*.R hold optional or credentialed scenarios.
  • Package metadata lives in DESCRIPTION, NAMESPACE, and Meta/; keep them in sync with roxygen2 updates.

Build, Test, and Development Commands

  • Rscript -e "devtools::load_all()" reloads the package for iterative development.
  • Rscript -e "devtools::test()" executes the full testthat suite; target a single file with testthat::test_file().
  • Rscript -e "devtools::check()" wraps R CMD check; resolve notes and warnings before pushing.
  • Rscript -e "pkgdown::build_site()" rebuilds the documentation site output in docs/.

Coding Style & Naming Conventions

  • Use tidyverse R style: 2-space indents, space after commas, and snake_case for locals; exported APIs stay in UpperCamelCase (loadResource() in loadResource.R).
  • Invoke packages explicitly with pkg::fn() and prefer glue for error text.
  • Keep roxygen2 blocks current and run devtools::document() whenever signatures change.
  • Avoid side effects on load; place initialization helpers in dedicated files under R/.

Testing Guidelines

  • Adopt testthat 3rd edition conventions; create new specs with usethis::use_test("feature") for consistent scaffolding.
  • Mock HTTP traffic with httptest fixtures where possible and store cassettes alongside tests.
  • Reserve _test-*.R for long-running or credentialed flows so CI remains fast and reproducible.

Commit & Pull Request Guidelines

  • Craft concise, present-tense summaries (<=72 chars), mirroring history like introducing collapsible callouts for getStep details; elaborate in the body when needed.
  • Reference issues as #123 and mention improve platform tickets in bodies.
  • Verify devtools::check() and targeted smoke tests before opening a PR; attach run output or logs.
  • PR descriptions should capture motivation, behavior changes, and screenshots or CLI transcripts when user-facing.

Documentation & Site Updates

  • Keep the pkgdown navigation _pkgdown.yml aligned with new articles or reference sections.
  • Update vignettes and long-form guides in vignettes/ when workflows change to prevent drift.
